items_flat.title_en: OpenAI drops GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by over 20%
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 Sol API 與積分定價下調逾 20%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a promotional price reduction for GPT-5.6 Sol on the API and eligible ChatGPT Work/Codex credits: input now $4/M tokens and output $20/M tokens (roughly 20% lower input and 33% lower output). The promo runs for the next three months (at least through November 21) and does not change Pro/Plus/Business subscription pricing.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 API 及符合資格的 ChatGPT Work／Codex 積分上實施促銷降價：輸入每百萬 token 4 美元、輸出 20 美元（輸入約降 20%、輸出約降 33%）。促銷至少持續至 11 月 21 日，Pro／Plus／Business 訂閱價格不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cut strengthens Sol’s price-performance against competing frontier models and may accelerate high-volume agentic and coding workloads. Key uncertainty is whether the promotional rates become permanent or revert after the three-month window.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此降價強化 Sol 相對於競爭 frontier 模型的性價比，可能加速高用量的 agentic 與 coding 工作負載。關鍵不確定性在於促銷價是否會在三個月後變成常態，或恢復原價。
items_flat.quote: As we continue to push the frontier of capabilities while improving efficiency, we’re dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next 3 months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在持續推進能力 frontier 並提升效率的同時，我們將 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 與積分定價在未來 3 個月下調逾 20%。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 已上架 Google 企業 Agent 平台
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is available via Google’s Enterprise Agent Platform (Model Garden). The model retains its 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels (low/medium/high/xhigh) at $2 / $0.50 cached / $6 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已可透過 Google 企業 Agent 平台（Model Garden）使用。模型維持 50 萬 token 上下文窗口與可配置推理等級（low/medium/high/xhigh），定價為每百萬 token 輸入 2 美元／快取 0.5 美元／輸出 6 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Adding a major cloud provider channel lowers friction for Google Cloud customers already using agent platforms and increases competitive pressure on pricing and availability of frontier models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 新增主要雲端供應商通路，降低已使用 agent 平台的 Google Cloud 客戶進入門檻，並對 frontier 模型的定價與可得性形成競爭壓力。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們很高興宣布，Grok 4.6 現已上架 Google 企業代理平台。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Bot expanded to more subscription plans
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Bot 擴大至更多訂閱方案
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI stated that Grok Bot (always-on AI teammates with their own computer) is now included with SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and all Cursor Teams plans, broadening access beyond the earlier limited rollout.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 表示 Grok Bot（具備獨立電腦的常駐 AI 隊友）現已包含於 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 以及所有 Cursor Teams 方案，擴大早期有限推出的使用範圍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Wider plan inclusion signals product maturation of persistent agent teammates and may drive higher engagement inside the Cursor and SuperGrok ecosystems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的方案納入顯示持久 agent 隊友產品趨於成熟，可能提升 Cursor 與 SuperGrok 生態系內的使用黏著度。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot is now available for SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and all Cursor Teams plans.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現已適用於 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 以及所有 Cursor Teams 方案。

brief_en: Quiet Sunday with no major new model or product launches from frontier labs. OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol promotional price cut (announced Friday) continues to draw coverage; xAI’s Grok 4.6 Google Cloud availability and broader Grok Bot plan access remain the notable recent moves.
brief_zh: 週日平靜，各大廠無重大新模型或產品發布。OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 促銷降價（週五宣布）持續受關注；xAI Grok 4.6 上架 Google 企業平台與 Grok Bot 擴大訂閱方案，仍是近期主要動態。
